selection_rule: One development-only intervention: equal observed class/patient-group sampling plus low-eta source-patient GroupDRO. The C1 inference graph, optimizer, seeds, calibration grid, and temporal replay are fixed.
promotion_rule: A post-development final protocol is required before blocks 5 or 6 may be opened. G1 requires fold consistency, five-seed variation, temporal event sensitivity, FAR, worst-patient diagnostics, parameter count, INT16 degradation, and hardware feasibility.

candidates.implementation: Same C1 inference graph: 15/47 multiscale depthwise input branches, 1x1 mixing, residual depthwise-separable 7/5/3 refinement with dilations 1/2/4. Only train-sampler and loss aggregation change.
candidates.inference_contract: raw causal 17x1280 EEG; Conv1D, depthwise Conv1D, pointwise Conv1D, BatchNorm, ReLU, AvgPool, residual add, global average pool, linear classifier
candidates.training_contract: Equal probability over observed (class, source patient group) strata with replacement; GroupDRO exponentiated-gradient source-group loss, eta 0.01; source patient identifiers are training-only and are not inputs or inference operators.
